title: Kerfur Omega Totems
description: Allows change totem models to Kerfur-Omega from VOTV (Voices of the Void)
body:
![MurMur :3](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/5qcm2FYV/images/9e37bba0683094debb296a989b0b0ad57d6411c0.png)

This resource pack you get several totems of  "Voice Of The Void".

**To get Kerfur-Omega, you need rename totem on the anvil.**

## Compatibility with the resource pack:

| Version             | Mods               | Result              |
|:---------------------:|:---------------------:|:---------------------:|
| Vanilla            | -              | ❌             |
| [Forge](<https://files.minecraftforge.net/net/minecraftforge/forge/> 'HELLO,')            | [Optifine](<https://optifine.net/downloads> 'I')              | ✅             |
| [Fabric](<https://fabricmc.net/use/installer/> 'NOT')            | [CIT Resewn](<https://modrinth.com/mod/cit-resewn/versions>  'MURKA!')              | ✅             |

## List of totems:

[Red_Kerfur](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/red-kerfur-omega-totem);
[Blue_Kerfur](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/blue-kerfur-omega-totem);
[Pink_Kerfur](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/pink-kerfur-omega-totem)

**You can also download a separate totem to replace all totems by clicking on their name.**
